params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Weakened Soul}}: '''Senna's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability|abilities}} mark enemy champions hit for 4 seconds. Subsequent attacks or ability hits against marked targets will consume the mark to grant '''Senna''' a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|Mist}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|1 to 10 for 10|formula=1% * level, capped at level 10|key=%}} of the target's '''current''' health}}, rendering the target immune to being marked again for a few seconds. This damage {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
params.description2:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Enemies that die near '''Senna''' may spawn a ''Mist Wraith'' from their corpse. A ''Mist Wraith'' lasts 8 seconds and '''Senna''' can basic attack or hit it with ''{{ai|Piercing Darkness|Senna}}'' or ''{{ai|Dawning Shadow|Senna}}'' to kill it instantly, granting her {{g|8}} and a stack of {{as|Mist}}.
* Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} will spawn a ''Mist Wraith''.
* Epic {{tip|monsters}} will spawn 2 ''Mist Wraiths''.
* {{tip|Minions}} and lesser {{tip|monsters}} that '''Senna''' kills have a 5% chance to spawn a ''Mist Wraith''.
* Large {{tip|minions}} that '''Senna''' does not kill will always spawn a ''Mist Wraith'', while lesser {{tip|minions}} and lesser {{tip|monsters}} that '''Senna''' does not kill have a 32% chance to spawn one.
* Lesser minions executed by an allied champion's {{nie|Support Quest}} item have a {{fd|8.4}}% chance to spawn a ''Mist Wraith''.
params.description3: {{sbc|Mist}}: For each stack of {{as|Mist}}, '''Senna''' gains {{sti|attack damage|{{as|{{fd|0.75}} '''bonus''' attack damage}}}}. For every 20 stacks, she also gains {{sti|attack range|20 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{sti|critical strike chance|{{as|10% critical strike chance}}}}. Additionally, every {{tt|{{as|1% critical strike chance}}|Counts critical strike chance from items and Mist stacks}} in excess of {{as|100%|critical strike chance}} is converted into {{fd|0.35}}% {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
params.description4: {{sbc|Innate - Relic Cannon}}: '''Senna's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} deal {{as|20% AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and grant her {{as|{{pp|key=%|10 to 20 for 3|1;6;9}} of the target's movement speed|ms}} as {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. The damage {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
params.notes:
* If a target's mark has a remaining duration less than {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and '''Senna''' starts her basic attack windup on the target during this time, the mark's duration will be modified to {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Subsequent windups on the marked target will refresh this modified duration if the previous attack windup did not complete.
* Despite the damage text showing 1 to ''Mist Wraiths'', attacking them will calculate the {{as|attack's damage|AD}} (including {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers) and any [[on-hit]] effects (including her ''Relic Cannon'' damage) for the purposes of {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|drain}} effects.
* ''Relic Cannon'' is only applied if the attack deals more than 0 damage.
** Hence, it is not applied if the target is {{tip|invulnerable}} or '''Senna's''' basic attack's {{sti|{{as|attack damage}}}} is reduced to 0 or below.
** The bonus damage is also not applied against {{tip|structures}} (regardless of their vulnerability).
* Dealing 0 damage is valid for marking and collecting {{as|Mist}} from champions, but dealing no damage at all is not.
** Hence, '''Senna''' can mark and collect from {{tip|invulnerable}} enemies.
** {{tip|Dodge}} prevents marking and collecting a {{as|Mist}} via '''Senna's''' basic attacks and {{ai|Q|Senna}}.
** {{Pending for test}}: {{as|Mist}} interaction with {{tip|block}} and {{tip|blind}}.
* {{as|Mist}} traveling to '''Senna''' can be {{tip|projectile|destroyed as a projectile}}.
* {{ci|Nunu|Nunu & Willump}} spawn a wraith each.
* Enemies will not see newly spawned wraiths while '''Senna''' is not visible.
* A wraith can be hit by {{cai|Cosmic Binding|Bard}} and it will interact with it the same way minions or monsters interact with Cosmic Binding but it will not take damage.
* ''Mist Wraith'' has a spawn animation, but is [[unit selection|targetable]] immediately.
* ''Mist Wraith'' grants a small amount of {{tip|sight}} around itself.
* {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} bolts will ignore ''Mist Wraiths''.
** Wind's Fury can still trigger if ''Mist Wraiths'' are the primary target.
* Attacking a ''Mist Wraith'' will not consume {{nie|Energized}}.
* {{tt|Excluding|Due to lack of available metric}} the range increase and the bonus shielding on {{ai|Dawning Shadow|Senna}}, one stack of {{as|Mist}} is worth {{g|{{#expr:0.75*{{#var:ad}}+{{#var:crit}}*10/20}}}} ({{g|+8}} from ''Mist Wraith'' pickup ({{g|{{#expr:0.75*{{#var:ad}}+{{#var:crit}}*10/20+8}}}} total)), {{g|{{#expr:0.75*{{#var:ad}}+{{#var:lifesteal}}*0.35*10/20}}}} if the critical chance is converted to life steal.
** {{sti|{{as|{{fd|0.75 AD}}}}}} is worth {{g|{{#expr:0.75*{{#var:ad}}}}}}.
** {{as|{{sti|critical chance|{{fd|0.5}}%}} critical strike chance}} is worth {{g|{{#expr:{{#var:crit}}*10/20}}}}.
*** {{as|{{sti|life steal|{{fd|0.175%}}}} life steal}} is worth {{g|{{fd|{{#expr:{{#var:lifesteal}}*0.35*10/20}}}}}}.
* The bonus on-hit damage applies an additional stack of {{iis|Black Cleaver}} {{nie|Carve}}.
* {{sti|Critical strike chance}} gained from {{iis|Yun Tal Wildarrows}} {{nie|Practice Makes Lethal}}, {{tt|Augments and {{ii|Stat Bonus|Stat bonuses}}|Both in Arena and ARAM: Mayhem}} do '''not''' interact with the life steal conversion.{{bug}}
* The buff will be granted even when hitting units that have zero movement speed (from which '''Senna''' cannot gain any movement speed).
** Attacking [[structures]] is special-cased to not grant it at all, however.
* [[Ping|Pinging]] ''Absolution'' in the HUD will send a chat message to the team that displays its stack count and her total {{sti|attack range}} accumulated.
params.tips:
* At high enough attack speed, and assuming '''Senna''' is at her max attack range when killing a unit that spawns a ''Mist Wraith'', she can collect it before they leave her attack range at all.
<!--blurb-->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate - Weakened Soul}}: {{cis|Senna}} {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|abilities}} against enemy {{tip|champions}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Mist'' for a few seconds. Subsequent hits collect the ''Mist'', dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''current''' health}} and rendering the target immune to further ''Mist'' applications for a few seconds.
params.blurb2: Enemies that die near '''Senna''' may spawn a ''Mist Wrath'' from their corpse, which lasts for a period. She can kill ''Mist Wraiths'' to gain {{g|gold}} and ''Mist'' stacks.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Innate - Relic Cannon}}: '''Senna's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and briefly grant her {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} based on the {{as|target's movement speed|ms}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Mist}}: For each stack, '''Senna''' gains {{sti|ad|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}. For every few stacks, she also gains {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}} and {{as|{{sti|critical strike chance}}}}, or {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} if she has max critical strike chance.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Senna}} fires a spectral laser toward the target unit. '''Senna''' and allied champions hit are {{tip|heal|healed}}. Enemies hit are dealt {{as|physical damage}}, which {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} effects, and {{tip|slow|slowed}} for a short time.
params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' fires a beam in the direction of the target unit. The beam consists of a wider ray of light, and a narrower ray of shadow at the center.

The shadow ray deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 15% {{as|(+ 15% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 7% per 100 AP)}} for a duration. The damage dealt to enemy champions {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
params.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 130}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Slow Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
params.description2: The light ray {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Senna''' and allied {{tip|champions}} hit.
params.description3: ''Piercing Darkness'' is {{tt|considered|Piercing Darkness doesn't actually apply basic damage}} to trigger a single {{tip|basic attack}} against {{tip|turrets}}, {{tip|wards}}, [[jungle plants]], {{ai|Absolution 3|Senna|Mist Wraiths}} and [[Champion_summoned_units#Targetable|any other attack-interactive units]] hit. It also applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|turrets}} hit, and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects against {{tt|one champion hit|see notes}}.
params.description4: ''Piercing Darkness' '' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 1 second {{tip|on-attack}}.
params.cast time: {{as|80% of '''Senna's''' windup time|as}} ({{fd|{{#expr:0.8*{{ccd|Senna|windup}}*(1/{{ccd|Senna|as_base}})round2}}}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the same champion it applies {{tip|on-attack}} effects to and {{tip|area damage}} to all other targets.
* The ability's cast time respects the attack speed [[Attack speed|floor and cap]].
** {{ri|Hail of Blades}} will spend a stack on hitting a champion with ''Piercing Darkness'' but only if {{ri|Hail of Blades}} was activated first by an auto-attack.
* '''Senna''' can generally target anything that is not either explicitly {{tip|untargetable}} or herself.
** Valid targets include anything that can be targeted by a basic attack from someone.
* ''Piercing Darkness'' respects all {{tip|turret}}-specific rules when striking them.
* {{tip|On-hit}} effects are applied in order of struck units' spawn IDs. This matters for effects that are consumed on-hit (e.g. {{tip|Spellblade}}), which are applied to the target with the lowest {{tt|Spawn ID|among enemy champions, this would also be the enemy first pick in Blind Pick mode}}.
** "Spawn ID" is an unofficial abbreviation to describe the spawn order for all units at the start of a game, below are some examples.
** If '''Senna''' targets an enemy champion but hits at least one more enemy champion simultaneously, {{ris|Press the Attack}} first stack will be applied to that target. If no champion was targeted, it will default to the champion with the lowest Spawn ID out of the ones struck by the ability. Whether the effect stacks up on a champion or not when multiple enemy champions are stuck also depends on Spawn ID.
** If ''Piercing Darkness'' struck an enemy champion and turret simultaneously, with {{ii|Rapid Firecannon}} fully charged, the passive effect will most likely trigger on the turret since towers are often spawned before champions.
* Similarly, {{tip|on-attack}} effects are applied in order of struck champions' spawn IDs. However, there are some specific on-attack effects that will apply to both the target of ''Piercing Darkness'' and the target with the lowest {{tt|Spawn ID|among enemy champions, this would also be the enemy first pick in Blind Pick mode}} if the two unit is not identical.{{bug|2}} {{tt|Confirmed cases|All under the condition that the targeted enemy champion does NOT have the lowest Spawn ID among all struck enemy champions}}:
** {{nie|Energized}} effects are stacked twice the amount.
** {{Pending for test}}
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent on-hit effects from being applied.
* {{Pending for test}} ''Piercing Darkness'' interaction with {{tip|dodge|dodging}}, {{tip|block|blocking}}, and {{tip|blind|blinding}} effects.
params.tips:
* Because '''Senna's''' windup percent scales down with levels but her windup time also only scales with 60% of attack speed bonuses, the precise numbers get complicated quickly.
** At base attack speed and level 1, '''Senna's''' attack windup is {{#expr:{{ccd|Senna|windup}}*(1/{{ccd|Senna|as_base}})round2}} seconds.
** A reduced formula for calculating ''Piercing Darkness' ''cast time at a given attack timer is '''80% of''' [ {{#expr:({{ccd|Senna|windup}}/{{ccd|Senna|as_base}})round3}} + {{#expr:{{ccd|Senna|windup_modifier}}*{{ccd|Senna|windup}}round4}}{{times}}(1{{divided by}}{{as|'''total''' attack speed|attack speed}}{{minus}}1{{divided by}}{{#expr:({{ccd|Senna|windup}}/{{ccd|Senna|as_base}})round3}}) ] seconds.
** The cast time equals {{rutngt|0.25}} (which is the standard for most abilities in ''League of Legends'') at approximately {{as|{{fd|204.3}}% '''bonus''' attack speed|attack speed}} (as of [[V25.10]]).
** Reducing '''Senna's''' attack speed via {{tip|cripple|attack speed reductions}} also increases ''Piercing Darkness' ''cast time by 60% of the amount.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Senna}} creates an aura of mist and gains {{tip|camouflage}} for a few seconds. She will quickly regain camouflage after breaking stealth.
params.blurb2: Allied champions that enter the mist gain ''Wraith Form'' for the remaining duration. '''Senna''' and allies camouflaged by ''Curse of the Black Mist'' also gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.blurb4: [[File:Curse of the Black Mist 2.png|20px|link=]] {{sbc|Wraith Form}}: Gain {{tip|camouflage}}. Enemies will have {{tip|obscured vision}} of camouflaged ''Wraiths'' moving outside the mist. ''Wraiths'' will quickly regain camouflage after breaking stealth.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' shrouds herself in an {{tip|aura}} of Black Mist and gains {{tip|camouflage}} for a duration. If '''Senna''' {{tip|breaks stealth|breaks the camouflage}}, she regains it after {{fd|1.75}} seconds without performing actions that break stealth.
params.description2: Allied champions who enter the mist gain ''Wraith Form'' for a duration equal to the aura's remaining duration.
params.description3: {{sbc|Wraith Form:}} Gain {{tip|camouflage}}. Enemies are granted {{tip|obscured vision}} of camouflaged ''Wraiths'' moving outside the mist within their line of {{tip|sight}}. ''Wraith Form'' can be regained if lost by breaking the camouflage after {{fd|1.75}} seconds without performing actions that break stealth. ''Wraith Form'' ends immediately upon '''Senna's''' {{tip|death}}.
params.description4: '''Senna''' and allies camouflaged by ''Curse of the Black Mist'' also gain {{sti|ms|{{as|20%|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
params.description5: '''''Senna''' can move during Curse of the Black Mist's cast time.''
params.notes:
* Allies affected by the ''Curse of the Blast Mist'' aura receive a buff called ''Cloak of Mist''.
* Obscured units appear as ''Wraiths'', hence the name. The wraith model does not distinguish which champion is obscured.
** On the [[Map (League of Legends)|mini-map]], obscured champions will be displayed as wraith icons instead of champion icons to the enemy team.
* In-game, the 'Cloak of Mist' buff grants camouflage and the 'Wraith Form' buff obscures the unit and grants movement speed. However, 'Cloak of Mist' has the unspecified effect of negating the obscuring effects of 'Wraith Form' (i.e. the unit is not a wraith while inside the mist); the unit has the bonus movement speed even when they are not a wraith (e.g. inside the mist or an enemy is nearby); and 'Wraith Form' also grants the functionality of camouflage (i.e. the unit is treated as a camouflaged unit with regards to {{tip|True Sight}}, {{ii|Control Ward|Control Wards}}, and enemy {{tip|champions}}).
** Given this overly complex interaction between the two buffs granted as well as the overlapping effects, it is easier to describe the effects as a single buff that is modified in specific circumstances rather than trying to establish a new game mechanic.
** '''Senna''' likewise has her aura buff and the 'Wraith Form' buff, but her 'Wraith Form' does not share gameplay functionality with other allies benefiting from Wraith Form. For '''Senna''', the appearance of being a wraith is a form-swap while camouflaged (similar to {{cai|Demon Shade|Evelynn}}). '''Senna''' will remain in her wraith form when she is detected so long as the camouflage effect isn't broken, and her wraith's appearance is very distinct from other wraiths.
* Allied champions who enter the mist and have {{tip|stealth}} of their own will still gain the ''Wraith Form'' buff but they will not grant {{tip|obscured vision}} of themselves to the enemy while out of the mist nor will they appear as a ''Wraith''.
** Allies who have their own {{tip|camouflage}} and also have ''Wraith Form'' will be revealed to enemies from their stealth's detection range, not ''Wraith Form's''.
* If '''Senna''' gains {{tip|invisibility}} while {{tip|camouflage|camouflaged}} by ''Curse of the Black Mist'', the visual effects of her aura will be hidden while she is invisible.
* ''Curse of the Black Mist'' will not activate if '''Senna''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} during the cast time.
* ''Wraith Form'' will not be granted to allies that are in a {{tip|zombie state}} or are {{tip|channel|channeling}}. It will be granted to allies even if they are {{tip|untargetable}}.
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.
** The stealth regain timer is refreshed from basic attacks at the start of their attack windup.
params.tips:
* Because of its duration, ''Curse of the Black Mist'' can be utilized in conjunction with {{bi|Homeguard}} when exiting the base, and importantly early in the lane.
** This is at the cost of mana, some of which will regenerate during the walk. Mana is consumed upon finishing the cast, so alternatively the caster can remain in base to regenerate some or all of the amount incurred, though delaying the journey back to lane. 
** To maximize the distance covered, due to [[Movement speed|movement speed caps]], use the ability when Homeguard's movement speed has dropped approximately below 500. This will allow '''Senna''' and any allies following her to keep a form of haste for a particularly long time.
* The haste and stealth combination can be highly effective in initiating ambushes from [[Fog of War]], since the number of teammates concealed can be difficult to discern.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Senna}} fires a massive beam in the target direction.
params.blurb2: Enemies in the center are dealt {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for a short time. '''Senna''' and allied champions hit by the beam are {{tip|shield|shielded}} for a short time.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' fires a massive beam in the target direction. The beam consists of a broad wave of light, and a narrow wave of shadow at the center.
params.description2: The shadow wave deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemy {{tip|champions}} hit and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for 3 seconds, as well as hits all ''{{ai|Absolution|Senna|Mist Wraiths}}''.
params.description3: The light wave grants a {{tip|shield}} to '''Senna''' and allied champions hit for 3 seconds, and grants {{tip|sight}} of {{tt|the area|Can see through brush and terrain.}} along the path for 2 seconds.
params.notes:
* The broad wave is a singular projectile that can be {{tip|projectile|destroyed}}.
** The narrow wave will be destroyed with it in the process.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* '''Senna''' reveals herself during the cast time.
params.tips: * On [[Summoner's Rift]], ''Dawning Shadow'' will take approximately {{ap|18000/20000}} seconds to land if fired from Nexus to Nexus or from the midpoint of bot lane to the midpoint of toplane.
